description: This file defines the API for the BBC micro:bit display, including structures, enums, macros, and function prototypes for displaying images and text on the micro:bit LED display.

methods.name: mb_display_get
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the micro:bit display object.

methods.name: mb_display_image
methods.description: Displays one or more images on the micro:bit display asynchronously.

methods.name: mb_display_print
methods.description: Prints a formatted string on the display with scrolling effect asynchronously.
